meta.name: seo-content-brief
meta.description: Generate competitive SEO content briefs with per-section word counts, competitor scoring, keyword density guidance, and page-type templates. Supports both new page briefs and improve-existing-page briefs. Use when user says "content brief", "write a brief", "content outline", "blog brief", "service page brief", "brief for", "writing brief", "content plan", or "outline for".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带字数分配和竞品评分的SEO内容简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站页面或博客文章撰写有竞争力的SEO内容简报。
copy.tagline_en: Generate SEO content briefs with word counts and competitor scoring.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need competitive SEO content briefs for web pages or blog posts.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的关键词或网址，生成一份 SEO 内容简报。简报包含竞争对手分析、每段字数建议、关键词密度指南和页面类型模板。它支持两种模式：为全新页面创建简报，或为已有页面提供改进建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“内容简报”、“写一份简报”、“内容大纲”、“博客简报”、“服务页面简报”、“简报”、“写作简报”、“内容计划”或“大纲”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请为关键词“SEO工具”生成一份内容简报。

say.note: Claude 会抓取页面内容，找出薄弱环节并给出优化建议。

say.text: 给我一个关于“内容营销”的大纲就行。
say.note: Claude 会输出简化版大纲，跳过详细分析部分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates an SEO content brief based on your keyword or URL. The brief includes competitor analysis, per-section word counts, keyword density guidance, and page-type templates. It supports two modes: creating a brief for a new page or improving an existing page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "content brief", "write a brief", "content outline", "blog brief", "service page brief", "brief for", "writing brief", "content plan", or "outline for".

say_en.text: Generate a content brief for the keyword "SEO tools".
say_en.note: Claude will analyze SERPs and produce a brief with outline and keyword guidance.

say_en.text: Help me improve this page: https://example.com/seo-guide
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the page, identify weaknesses, and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: Just give me an outline for "content marketing".
say_en.note: Claude will output a simplified outline without detailed analysis.
